title: Verify the August Shard Boundary Exactly
teaser: Monthly content must stay inside its own civil-date range.
full_text: Compile the August shard and verify it contains only the exact dates from August 1 through August 31 2035.

title: Fail Explicitly When UT1 Data Is Missing
teaser: Missing Earth-orientation data must not become an invisible approximation.
full_text: Run a fixture without an IERS record and verify the calculation layer returns a clear missing-data result instead of guessing.

title: Lock House Cusps to Canonical Order
teaser: Normalized house starts must retain their intended sequence.
full_text: Generate all twelve cusps for a natal fixture and verify canonical ordering plus degree normalization stay identical across runs.

title: Do Not Show Stale Results During Loading
teaser: A new calculation must not display values from the previously selected profile.
full_text: Switch profiles and start recalculation then verify the loading state hides prior chart values until the new result is ready.

title: Build Restore Preview Counts Before Mutation
teaser: Users should know insert update and conflict impact before choosing merge or replace.
full_text: Open a backup in preview mode and verify impact counts are calculated before any persistent write occurs.

title: Recheck Integrity After Restore Rollback
teaser: A failed restore must leave the original data state intact.
full_text: Inject an error during restore and verify post-rollback table hashes and manifest summary match the starting state.

title: Restrict PDF Font Fallback to Licensed Assets
teaser: Missing glyphs must not silently select an unknown system font.
full_text: Generate a report with Turkish text and astrology symbols and verify every used font has license and hash provenance in the manifest.

title: Keep Domain Enum IDs Independent of Locale
teaser: Display language must never alter persisted domain identities.
full_text: Open the same record in Turkish and English and verify enum plus feature IDs remain byte-for-byte stable.

title: Cap Repeated Rewarded Unlocks
teaser: Repeated ads must not accumulate temporary access without limit.
full_text: Complete a second rewarded flow while an unlock is active and verify duration remains within the contracted cap policy.

title: Reject Path Traversal Inside Backups
teaser: Archive entries must never write outside the application sandbox.
full_text: Create a malicious zip entry containing parent-directory traversal and verify security validation rejects it before extraction.

title: Resolve UUID Import Collisions Deterministically
teaser: Matching identifiers must not trigger silent overwrites.
full_text: Import a fixture sharing a UUID with an existing profile and verify merge handling returns the same stable conflict outcome every time.

title: Require Meaningful Semantics for Icon Controls
teaser: Visual meaning alone is insufficient for screen-reader users.
full_text: Pass an unlabeled icon control through semantics validation and verify accessibility cannot pass without a descriptive label.

title: Keep Cards Usable at Large Text Scale
teaser: Accessibility text scaling must not push essential actions out of reach.
full_text: Render primary screens at the highest supported text scale and verify controls remain visible unclipped and operable.

title: Persist Stable Geographic IDs for Locations
teaser: A city label alone must not be the stored identity of a selected place.
full_text: Choose one of two same-name cities and verify persistence uses the stable provider ID with coordinates rather than only the label.

title: Expose Both Offsets During a DST Fold
teaser: Repeated local clock times must not be accepted without identifying the intended instant.
full_text: Submit an ambiguous fall-back time and verify both valid offset choices are presented explicitly.

title: Block Ephemeris Providers on Checksum Failure
teaser: Modified astronomy data must never initialize as a trusted source.
full_text: Flip one bit in bundled ephemeris bytes and verify startup integrity checks prevent provider initialization.

title: Lock Applying and Separating Aspect Direction
teaser: Aspect phase must not invert because relative motion signs are interpreted inconsistently.
full_text: Calculate known planetary fixtures and verify applying versus separating states match the relative-motion golden baseline.

title: Apply Master-Number Rules Consistently
teaser: Preservation of 11 22 and 33 must not differ between calculation entry points.
full_text: Run one numerology fixture through summary and detail flows and verify identical master-number handling.

title: Normalize Five-Element Totals Deterministically
teaser: BaZi element weights must not drift because of display rounding.
full_text: Calculate a known pillar fixture and verify normalized totals plus displayed percentages remain deterministic.

title: Reject Release Assets Without Provenance
teaser: A file is not release-ready merely because it exists in the repository.
full_text: Remove provenance metadata from one manifested asset and verify the release validator blocks the package for missing evidence.

title: Resolve Offline PRO Ownership from Persisted Proof
teaser: Network loss must not revoke previously verified lifetime access.
full_text: Enable airplane mode after verified ownership and confirm offline entitlement remains correct from the signed persisted proof.

title: Stop Writes When Database Integrity Fails
teaser: New mutations must not continue on top of a corrupted local store.
full_text: Launch with a failing integrity fixture and verify writes remain blocked until a supported repair or safe error path completes.

title: Measure Search Latency Against a Defined Budget
teaser: Catalog search should not degrade without detection as data grows.
full_text: Run repeated queries over a production-scale bundled catalog and verify p95 latency stays within the documented performance budget.

title: Redact Birth Data from Logs
teaser: Diagnostic output must not expose sensitive profile fields in plaintext.
full_text: Trigger an error fixture containing birth date and coordinates and verify logs retain only approved redacted fields.

title: Match PDF Preview Sections to Final Bytes
teaser: Every section selected in preview must appear in the generated report.
full_text: Choose several report sections and verify preview planning plus final PDF section lists match by stable section ID.

title: Lock CSV BOM and Encoding Behavior
teaser: Text decoding must not depend on platform defaults.
full_text: Import canonical UTF-8 fixtures with and without BOM and verify both produce the same normalized records.

title: Handle Notification Permission Denial Safely
teaser: Permission refusal must not create an endless prompt loop.
full_text: Deny notification permission and verify settings show a clear disabled state with an appropriate retry path.

title: Test Persisted Schema Compatibility After Upgrade
teaser: An application update must not make existing user data inaccessible.
full_text: Open prior-release fixture data in the new build and verify profiles calculations and notes survive migration.

title: Scan August for Historical Exact Duplicates
teaser: Fresh editorial copy must not repeat text from earlier English shards verbatim.
full_text: Compare August English title teaser and full-text fields against all prior English shards and reject any exact collision.

title: Review English as Its Own August Editorial Track
teaser: English content must not depend on Turkish rows or cross-locale fallback.
full_text: Audit the August English shard under independent quality rules and verify every record is complete on its own.

title: Close August Coverage from Committed Shards
teaser: Progress must be based only on contiguous content reloaded from main.
full_text: Reload both August shards from main verify thirty one canonical dates per locale and record September 1 2035 as the next exact start.
